description:
Fair Deal Property Your Trusted Partners for Residential Property Sales

Are delighted to present to you for sale the truly enchanting and exclusively situated “Knockma Cottage” 

They say what is rare is wonderful, and this home is indeed a cherished rarity that is rich in wonder.

This home is uniquely positioned at the end of a delightfully private tree lined avenue offering the ultimate in seclusion whilst remaining within striking distance of Galway City.

The property sits on a majestic site of well over an acre of beautifully planted and exceptionally idyllic surrounds creating an oasis of stillness and natural beauty which is rarity in the modern era. 

Family-built in the millennium year and lovingly cared for by the same family ever since, this beautiful stone-fronted four-bedroom dormer bungalow with additional attic conversion offers something completely out of the ordinary.

From the moment you arrive, it is clear this is a home of exceptional quality. Elegant galvanised steel gates, framed by handcrafted red brick and field limestone pillars, open onto a silver birch-lined driveway bordered by beautiful hand-built stone walls and colourful seasonal planting featuring snowdrops, daffodils, primroses, tulips and fuschia. The impressive stone façade and solid teak front door provide the perfect introduction to the craftsmanship and attention to detail that continues throughout the home.

Step inside and you'll discover warm, inviting living spaces designed for family life. The sitting room is centred around a magnificent handcrafted brick and stone fireplace with a reclaimed timber mantelpiece, while the large bay window, complete with built-in seating and storage, captures  views of Croagh Patrick in the distance. 

The spacious south-facing kitchen and adjoining sunroom are flooded with natural light from morning through to evening, creating a welcoming heart to the home where family and friends will naturally gather.

Accommodation includes four generous bedrooms, while the converted attic provides exceptional additional flexibility with three separate rooms along with a toilet and wash hand basin—ideal for a home office, guest accommodation, hobbies, or growing families.

Outside, approximately one acre of mature private grounds offers endless possibilities, complete with established gardens, large steel storage shed, a vegetable plot, beautifully maintained patios and pathways, and an exceptional sense of peace and seclusion.

Practicality is every bit as impressive as presentation. A brand new chimney, together with a fully certified computer-controlled wastewater treatment system installed in June 2026, means the new owners can move in with complete confidence. Freshly painted inside and out, along with newly power-washed patios, pathways and stonework, this home is presented in genuine move-in condition.

The location offers the perfect balance between countryside tranquillity and everyday convenience. You're just minutes from a TFI bus connection and motorway access, fields away from a modern primary school, and within easy reach of Knockma Walking Trail, Lough Corrib, Ross Abbey, Lisdonagh House and Castlehacket House.

If you've been seeking a beautifully crafted family home where quality, privacy, space and location are perfectly combined then your search for home may be about to find its rest here in the enchanting Knockma Cottage.

To arrange your personal viewing, contact Fair Deal Property today—your trusted experts for residential property sales.


Key Features at a Glance

 Family-built (2000) and single-family owned four-bed dormer bungalow

 Approximately 1 acre of land to the rear with full privacy

 South-facing kitchen and sunroom

 Converted attic with 3 rooms, toilet, and hand basin

 Elegant galvanized gates set into hand-built red brick and field limestone pillars

 Silver birch-lined driveway with hand-built stone walls and seasonal planting

 Solid teak front door with stone-fronted exterior

 Elevated position set back from the road for peace and tranquillity

 Hand-built brick and stone fireplace with reclaimed wooden mantelpiece

 Bay window seating and storage with views of Croagh Patrick on clear days

 Brand new chimney

 Brand new computer-controlled wastewater treatment system — certified June 2026

 Mature grounds, shrubs, and side vegetable garden

 Freshly power-washed patios, paths, and stone frontage; painted inside and out turn-key condition

 Minutes from TFI bus connection and motorway access

 Fields from a modern all-purpose primary school

 Within a few miles of Knockma walking trail, Lough Corrib (Luimnagh Pier), Ross

Abbey, Lisdonagh House, and Castlehacket House
